text:
Formester's Drag-and-drop functionality and pre-designed templates make creating forms extremely quick and easy. It's extensive customisation options allows you to tailor forms to your specific needs and branding. The conditional logic, file uploads, and integrations with popular tools like Mailchimp and Zapier make Formester extremely versatile too.

I was also impressed with their exceptional support. The team was prompt, knowledgable and friendly in addressing my questions. Since I started using Formester in Dec 2023, the developers have added the quiz function and the provision to add multiple fields in the same row.
